{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Check if the groups are comparable
# Cross-tabulate arm vs severity, arm vs sex
print("Cross-tabulation: arm vs severity")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']))

print("\nCross-tabulation: arm vs sex")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['sex']))

# Compute the difference in response rates
control_response_rate = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
treatment_response_rate = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

print(f"\nControl response rate: {control_response_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Treatment response rate: {treatment_response_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect:.4f}")"}
